releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.14.2 - Seamless Travel Eco & Popup Removal:
- Removed intrusive 'NVIDIA GPU settings have been reset' popup dialog when activating Travel Eco or switching presets.
- Seamless, non-disruptive preset switching with sleek toast notifications.
- Preserved display refresh rate switching and D3Cold 0.0W GPU sleep.
